text: 美国五三银行首席美国经济学家Bill Adams预计，受汽油价格反弹推动，美国9月CPI将再次出现较高涨幅。燃料成本上升也可能推高属于核心CPI组成部分的机票价格。预计核心CPI的其他分项涨幅将相对温和。随着经销商通过降价促销消化库存，新车和二手车价格可能小幅下降。其他大多数耐用消费品的价格预计变化不大。住房通胀可能再次放缓，反映去年和今年初房价与租金温和上涨的滞后传导效应。PPI涨幅可能高于CPI，因为9月柴油价格涨幅超过汽油，而柴油价格对生产者成本的影响更大。运输和仓储费用也可能大幅上涨，推动核心PPI走高。受残余季节性因素影响，医疗保健服务价格涨幅
text_en: Bill Adams, Chief US Economist at Fifth Third Bank, expects that US September CPI will again show a relatively high increase, driven by a rebound in gasoline prices. Rising fuel costs may also push up airfare prices, which are part of core CPI. Other components of core CPI are expected to rise relatively modestly. New and used vehicle prices may decline slightly as dealers clear inventory through discounts and promotions. Prices for most other durable goods are expected to change little. Housing inflation may slow again, reflecting the lagged pass-through effects of moderate increases in home prices and rents last year and earlier this year. PPI inflation may be higher than CPI because September diesel prices rose more than gasoline, and diesel prices have a greater impact on producer costs.
